english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something foolishly or stupidly.

examples.english: I foolishly trusted a stranger and didn't even realize I'd been scammed.
examples.traditional: 我傻傻地信咗個陌生人，畀人呃咗都唔知。
